articles.title: Sterlite Technologies secures OFNP US certification for AI data center fiber
articles.description: Sterlite Technologies secured OFNP US certification for its fiber trunk assemblies. The products comply with NFPA 262 standards for indoor air-handling spaces. The portfolio includes 48 to 576F Intermittently Bonded Ribbon (IBR) assemblies. The certification targets AI data center infrastructure and hyperscale deployments.
articles.content:
Sterlite Technologies has secured Optical Fiber Nonconductive Plenum (OFNP) US certification for its high-density fiber trunk assemblies, strengthening its position in the AI data center infrastructure market.

articles.title: Scientists visualize proteins' hidden water architecture that may help define biological function
articles.description: For decades, scientists have understood proteins primarily through two defining features: their amino acid sequence and their three-dimensional structure. This framework has driven major advances in biology, biotechnology and medicine, culminating in recent artificial intelligence tools capable of predicting protein structures with remarkable accuracy.
